note: The block's mounting coordinate system (MCS) and Origin datum. The STEP contains no explicitly named MCS/Origin construction entity (no CONSTRUCTIVE_GEOMETRY_REPRESENTATION and no named AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D); instead the designer re-based the block so its component/world origin coincides with the mounting frame (exactly what the filename '(Origin & MCS)' advertises). Both the assembly-root placement (#11214) and the block body's local placement (#11215) are identity at (0,0,0), confirming the attachment frame is the world origin. Axes are scale-invariant (origin at 0, unit vectors), so this frame applies directly to the mesh at any scale; the mesh and these coordinates are expressed in cm to match the project convention (toolblock-3x-real.glb ~17 cm and the turret joint UCS targets are in cm).

axisSemantics.toolForwardAxis: +X: the drills/taps exit the block toward +X (body ends near x=5.25 cm; tool tips reach x=13.5 cm).
axisSemantics.intoFaceAxis: +Z: the broad flat mounting flange is the block's top face (normal +Z); the block body hangs below it in -Z, so +Z is the seating/pin direction pointing into the turret. Inferred from the block body AABB relative to the origin (origin sits ~1.2 cm below the +Z top face; body extends -10.6 cm in -Z and -8.8 cm in -Y).
axisSemantics.thirdAxis: +Y = intoFaceAxis x toolForwardAxis (Z x X), completing a right-handed frame.

mcs.role: assembly-root placement of the 3X Spot-Drill-Tap shape representation (the block world/MCS frame)

originDatum.role: block body (EWS_222115_DIN4003) local placement; mapped into the assembly root with identity translation
